description: This file defines the TransactionClient class which implements transaction management logic for Orleans transactions, including starting, running, and finalizing transactions with various options.

classes.name: TransactionClient
classes.description: Implements transaction management for Orleans, handling transaction execution, finalization, and context management.

methods.name: RunTransaction
methods.description: Runs a transaction with a specified option and delegate, supporting both void and boolean return types.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithDisallowedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate when transactions are disallowed, throwing if a transaction context exists.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithSupportedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate within a supported transaction context, or without one if none exists.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithSupressedTransaction
methods.description: Executes a delegate with the transaction context suppressed.

methods.name: RunDelegateWithTransaction
methods.description: Starts or forks a transaction, sets context, executes delegate, and handles commit or abort.

methods.name: FinalizeTransaction
methods.description: Finalizes a transaction by resolving or aborting based on its state and exceptions.
